facts.fact: Sierra Leone's President launched the National Investment Board's Online Business Registration System on 10 November 2026, which the document says brings 66 NIB services online (seven registration, 53 post-registration, five document and an appeals service) for applying, uploading documents, tracking and obtaining certificates.
